description: This Swift file defines the ScreenController class, which manages a WebView for displaying web-based UI in a mobile application. It handles URL navigation, WebView snapshotting, debug status rendering, and communication between the web UI and native code via JavaScript evaluation and callbacks.

classes.name: ScreenController
classes.description: A final class managing a WebView for UI rendering, URL navigation, and JavaScript communication within an iOS app.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigate to a given URL string with optional trust for A2UI actions.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reload the WebView with current URL or default scaffold if URL is empty.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enable or disable debug status display.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Set the debug status title and subtitle for display.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Apply current debug status settings to the WebView via JavaScript.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Update the home canvas state with a JSON string.

methods.name: applyHomeCanvasStateIfNeeded
methods.description: Invoke JavaScript to render the home state in the WebView.

methods.name: waitForA2UIReady
methods.description: Asynchronously wait until the A2UI is ready within a timeout period.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the WebView and return the result as a string.

methods.name: snapshotPNGBase64
methods.description: Capture a PNG snapshot of the WebView, encoded as base64.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Capture a snapshot of the WebView in specified format (PNG or JPEG), encoded as base64.

methods.name: snapshotImage
methods.description: Take a snapshot of the WebView as a UIImage.

methods.name: attachWebView
methods.description: Attach a WKWebView instance to this controller and initialize it.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasUIURL
methods.description: Check if a URL points to a trusted canvas UI resource.

methods.name: parseA2UIActionBody
methods.description: Parse a body of an A2UI action message into a dictionary.
